# servcat

`servcat` provides an R interface to ServCat, the authoritative
repository for U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) data and reference
information.

Use this package to search ServCat, retrieve reference metadata, inspect
related units and subject categories, access saved collections, retrieve
lookup values, and download files associated with ServCat references.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `servcat` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/USFWS/servcat) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("USFWS/servcat")
```

Then load the package:

``` r

library(servcat)
```

## Usage

A typical workflow might look like this:

``` r

library(servcat)

# Search ServCat
results <- search_references(
  criteria = list(
    quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"
  ),
  top = 100,
  composite = TRUE,
  all_pages = TRUE
)

# Inspect a known reference ID
ref <- get_references(140411)

# Retrieve related metadata
keywords <- get_keywords(140411)
files <- get_files(140411)
units <- get_units(140411)
subjects <- get_subjects(140411)
bboxes <- get_bboxes(140411)
taxa <- get_taxa(140411)

# Download associated files and inspect per-file status
downloaded_files <- download_files(
  reference_id = 140411,
  path = "data-raw/servcat-files"
)

downloaded_files[, c("resourceId", "success", "error")]
```

## Getting help

Contact a [project maintainer](mailto:mccrea_cobb@fws.gov) for help with
this repository.

## Contribute

Contact the [project maintainer](mailto:mccrea_cobb@fws.gov) for
information about contributing to this repository.

Submit a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/USFWS/servcat/issues) to
report a bug or request a feature or enhancement.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`download_files()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/download_files.md)
  : Download files from a ServCat reference
- [`get_bboxes()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_bboxes.md)
  : Get bounding boxes from a ServCat reference
- [`get_bibliography()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_bibliography.md)
  : Get bibliography metadata for a ServCat reference
- [`get_collection_references()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_collection_references.md)
  : Get references in a saved collection
- [`get_files()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_files.md)
  : Get digital file information from a ServCat reference
- [`get_keywords()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_keywords.md)
  : Get keywords from a ServCat reference
- [`get_lifecycle()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_lifecycle.md)
  : Get lifecycle information for a ServCat reference
- [`get_links()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_links.md)
  : Get links from a ServCat reference
- [`get_owners()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_owners.md)
  : Get owners for a ServCat reference
- [`get_reference_summaries()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_reference_summaries.md)
  : Get ServCat reference summaries by ID
- [`get_references()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_references.md)
  : Get ServCat references by ID
- [`get_subjects()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_subjects.md)
  : Get subject categories from a ServCat reference
- [`get_taxa()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_taxa.md)
  : Get taxa associated with a ServCat reference
- [`get_units()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/get_units.md)
  : Get units associated with a ServCat reference
- [`list_access_constraints()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/list_access_constraints.md)
  : List valid ServCat access constraint text
- [`list_date_precisions()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/list_date_precisions.md)
  : List valid ServCat date precision choices
- [`list_file_tags()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/list_file_tags.md)
  : List valid ServCat file processing tags
- [`list_reference_type_groups()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/list_reference_type_groups.md)
  : List valid ServCat reference type groups
- [`list_reference_types()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/list_reference_types.md)
  : List valid ServCat reference types
- [`list_subject_categories()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/list_subject_categories.md)
  : List valid ServCat subject categories
- [`list_web_service_types()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/list_web_service_types.md)
  : List valid ServCat web service types
- [`search_references()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/search_references.md)
  : Search ServCat references
- [`servcat`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/servcat-package.md)
  [`servcat-package`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/servcat-package.md)
  : servcat: Access the ServCat REST API
- [`service_version()`](https://usfws.github.io/servcat/reference/service_version.md)
  : Get the current ServCat service version
